userInputText: Black Hole Wars Hole.io - Devour the World and Dominate the Black Hole Universe The gameplay of Black Hole Wars is similar to the snake eating game but more exciting, and the personalized skin system is added to make your black hole unique and super eye-catching! Have you ever fantasized about controlling a black hole and sucking everything into the city? Now, that crazy dream has come true! In Hole.io Black Hole Wars, transform into a hungry black hole and begin your journey to devour, from roadside trash cans to skyscrapers and entire cities!
